source: THE OWNER'S OWN MESHY SESSION plus a Mixamo auto-rig, 2026-08-02 (board SG-88) - the SG-74/SG-85 route again. Nothing in this folder was generated by tools/meshy.py, so there is no prompt, no task id and no credit line; ingestion was one tools/models.json entry and one pipeline run.
delivered_as: Male Locomotion Pack (1).zip - 10 animation-only clips on that same rig
Meshy_AI_Little_Adventurer_0802232831_texture_obj.zip - the textures, because the Mixamo FBX is grey
role_verified_by: The painted crewman (assets/art/allies/crew_front_idle.png) is a young sailor in a blue coat and a knitted beanie with a cross-strap, holding a pike. So is this, down to the beanie and the sash. Filmed at the real camera in .shots/clips/crew.gif.
screen_units_from: 120 + SkyGearLanes.CREW.radius * 3 - the renderer's own figure arithmetic on the number the SIMULATION already keeps for a crewman. The handoff spec asked for '~1.7 m, a touch under the captain's 176' and the sim's own answer landed inside it.
one_mesh_serves_all: The crew are identical by design (handoff-3d/README.md), so there is one mesh and every crewman on the deck is a skeleton driving it.
tex_note: 1024: 165 ground units is 309 pixels at the shipped camera, over tools/meshy.py's TEX_FULL_ABOVE_PX of 260. The delivered sheet was 4096 (27 MB of PNG) and came down to 1.4 MB.
archive_shape: A DIRECTORY, not a zip - the clips arrived in three deliveries and tools/ingest_model.py's `unpack` already returns a directory unchanged, so a pack that arrives in pieces needs no re-zip to be ingestible.
